economicRule: Use the frozen Trial 2 strategy, dates, sizing, costs, execution prices, funding normalization, margin stress, comparators, and anti-rescue rule without modification.
motivation: The original Trial 2 monthly markPrice source failed before economics because 24 required scheduled boundaries were absent. A daily-only full-window replication also failed before economics because 11 daily mark archives were unavailable. Before any Trial 2 economic result, a non-economic checksum-verified source audit established that the monthly and daily markPrice archive families agree exactly wherever both exist and their union covers the entire frozen grid.

markPriceSourceRule.monthly: checksum-verified Binance Vision MONTHLY USD-M BTCUSDT 8h markPriceKlines
markPriceSourceRule.daily: checksum-verified Binance Vision DAILY USD-M BTCUSDT 8h markPriceKlines when the adjacent official .CHECKSUM and archive both exist
markPriceSourceRule.selection: Build both source maps independently for the entire frozen 2021-05-01 through 2026-03-01 window. At every scheduled 8-hour boundary, use the mark value if present in either source. If both sources contain the boundary they must be numerically identical; any disagreement aborts evaluation. If neither contains the boundary, abort. No interpolation, forward fill, backward fill, nearest-price substitution, or outcome-based source selection is permitted.
markPriceSourceRule.provenance: Preserve archive URL, official expected SHA-256, observed SHA-256, archive granularity, period, and availability status.

unchangedOtherSources.spot: checksum-verified Binance Vision DAILY BTCUSDT 8h spot klines, exactly as Trial 2
unchangedOtherSources.perpetualExecution: checksum-verified Binance Vision MONTHLY USD-M BTCUSDT standard 8h klines, exactly as Trial 2
unchangedOtherSources.funding: checksum-verified Binance Vision MONTHLY USD-M BTCUSDT fundingRate archives, exactly as Trial 2

antiRescueRule: No strategy/economic parameter or source-selection rule may change after the first Trial 2U economic output. Any later source or strategy change requires a new labeled replication/trial.
interpretation: A positive result is historical robustness/source-replication evidence only. It is not pristine forward validation and cannot authorize live trading.
